description: 035-SELFCHAIN: Structure 1 v3 canonical CBOR fixture — prev_own_hash appended at index 7. RFC 8949 §4.2.1.
_note: Canonical CBOR of the 8-element positional TBS array for protocol_version=3. Inputs 1-6 are byte-for-byte the ones in structure1-v2-canonical.json, so the three files together prove the field is APPENDED and no existing index moved: strip the leading '8803' and the trailing 32-byte hash from this hex, and the remainder is the v2 hex after its leading '8702'.
_why: prev_own_hash is the content hash of the SENDER'S OWN previous message in this session. last_seen_hash chains a sender to the counterparty; this chains them to themselves. Without it, two messages sent back to back are indistinguishable in the signed bytes — both acknowledge the same message from the other side — so whoever hands the conversation to a new relay can swap them. A sender's first message in a session carries computeGenesisPrevRoot for that session, never zeros.
